title: perfcheck ids against the test-id baseline exits 1 on main: 232 ids moved with the backlog split and count as removed
goal: perfcheck.py ids --against exits 0 on main: a test id whose test now lives in another file (the backlog split moved TestBacklogLand and others out of test_backlog.py) is matched by class and test name and counts as moved, not removed, while a really removed test still fails unless _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt names it; a test named perfcheck_ids_moved plants a moved and a removed test. Found by BG-anaeycii's worker: 232 baseline ids are no longer collected, none from its change; it also breaks ST-7ihohi2u's done check and ST-f57fq7np's proof that a speed-up lost no test.
